key.province: INDEC 2-digit jurisdiction code (department_code, text with leading zero)
key.department: INDEC 5-digit code = province + 3 digits (municipality_code); CABA's 15 comunas are its departments (02007-02105)

point_method: Georef centroid of each department (centroide_lat/lon), as published; no centroids computed here.

boundaries.source: Georef GeoJSON (IGN), as published (already generalised by Georef); converted to MultiPolygon, 5 decimals

limitations: Georef has 529 departments including Antártida Argentina (94028) and Islas del Atlántico Sur (94021). Census tables publish Tierra del Fuego by department as listed in unmatched when codes differ.
